Neuralink’s Blindsight product is now just waiting for regulatory approval

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Elon Musk megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: X Freeze (@XFreeze); megjelent: 2026-11-20T13:30:55+00:00; link: https://x.com/XFreeze/status/2123771069354152204; média: videó, 37 másodperc]
Elon Musk just gave a massive update on Neuralink's Blindsight

"And our next product is what we call Blindsight

So Blindsight is a neural implant that interfaces directly with the visual cortex and enables people who are completely blind to see

So it allows you to be wearing glasses or something like that that have a camera

That camera is transmitting to the Neuralink device that then transfers the signals to your visual cortex, enabling someone who is completely blind meaning blind in both eyes or lost optic nerve potentially someone who has been blind from birth, to see”
